input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Factorio game sprite atlas, Personnel Deployment Office, four cardinal directions.
Primary request: Create a polished, highly readable 2x2-tile industrial office machine that materializes hired biters and releases them onto a walking lane. Replace a crude arrow placeholder with a real small industrial building.
Scene/backdrop: TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no scenery, ground, backdrop or gradient.
Subject: squat compact steel bureaucratic checkpoint kiosk on a square mechanical base, worn dark blue enamel and rusted bronze fittings matching rusty blue road signs, small paperwork terminal, bundled cables, amber status light, an obvious low open biter exit aperture with modest yellow hazard edging. A cream arrow on a flat roof plate points toward the exit. No creatures or people.
Style/medium: detailed pre-rendered 3D industrial machinery sprite matching Factorio's gritty realistic machinery, crisp readable forms at small game size.
Composition/framing: ONE 2x2 sheet with four separate complete sprites: TOP LEFT exits NORTH/up, TOP RIGHT exits EAST/right, BOTTOM LEFT exits SOUTH/down, BOTTOM RIGHT exits WEST/left. All four depict exactly the SAME machine and proportions, same lighting and fixed camera; only the cardinal placement of the exit and roof arrow changes. Do not rotate the entire image or change the camera between frames. Factorio orthographic elevated view from the south, looking down about 60 degrees; ground-grid axes are horizontal/vertical, not a diamond isometric grid. Compact square ground footprint. Each sprite centered within its quadrant, feet aligned to the same baseline, generous transparent margins, consistent size.
Lighting/mood: warm neutral key light from upper left, mild contact shading contained in the machine; no long cast shadow.
Constraints: no readable letters or words, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no large floating arrow, no platform protruding outside the square footprint, no cropped parts. All space outside the four machines must have alpha=0. Deliver transparent PNG.

Use case: stylized-concept

Primary request: Create a polished, highly readable 2x2-tile industrial office machine that receives hired biters from ANY of its four sides and dematerializes them back into personnel items.
Scene/backdrop: TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no scenery, ground, backdrop or gradient.
Subject: compact squat square industrial checkpoint kiosk, worn dark blue enamel steel and rusted bronze fittings, paperwork terminal and a few cream forms, cable bundles, small teal status light. FOUR IDENTICAL low open intake apertures, one centered on EACH side of the square base, with restrained yellow-black hazard edging. The south and east openings are clearly visible; north and west opening rims remain readable from the elevated view. A raised compact central roof contains a metallic recessed square dematerializer hatch, surrounded by four short identical conduits. Symmetric intake layout, no outgoing side and NO arrows anywhere.
Style/medium: detailed pre-rendered 3D industrial machinery sprite matching Factorio's gritty realistic machinery, crisp readable forms at small game size. Match a rusty blue industrial arrow sign and a blue steel deployment office with bronze tanks, paperwork and amber indicator; the reception office uses a teal indicator and no arrow.
Composition/framing: ONE complete centered machine, generous transparent margins. Fixed Factorio orthographic elevated view from south, looking down about 60 degrees; square ground-grid axes horizontal/vertical rather than a diamond isometric grid. The entire machine fits a compact square ground footprint. Machinery sits within the 2x2 footprint; no long ramps or arms.
Lighting/mood: warm neutral key light from upper left, mild contact shading contained in the machine; no long cast shadow.
Constraints: no readable letters or words, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no UI, NO direction arrows, no people or creatures, no cropped parts. Every pixel outside the machine must be genuinely transparent alpha=0. Deliver transparent PNG.
